creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-10-16, the 0.16 cask on the laptop. An agent asked to check whether Muster renders Kitty graphics, iterating on screenshots, could not capture anything from its pane: `screencapture -x out.png` and `screencapture -l<window id>` both failed with "could not create image from display/window". The responsible process for its pane was `Muster.app/Contents/Library/MusterSessions.app/.../muster-daemon` (`dev.amterp.muster.sessions`). The person granted Screen Recording to that app and capture still failed, perhaps because a grant applies only once the daemon restarts, which ends every pane. docs/observations/macos-26.4.1.md sections 8 and 9 say pane requests are judged against Muster.app's grant, so which grant was missing is not established. The person took the screenshot by hand.

A `muster pane screenshot [--pane REF] [--out PATH]`, or a window-level one, answered by the app would let an agent check what `pane read` text cannot show: images, colors, layout. The app draws those pixels and needs no Screen Recording permission to read its own views. Failing that, once it is measured, `muster docs limits` could say which app a pane's capture needs granted and when the grant takes effect.
title: An agent cannot screenshot its own window
